Psalm 78:22: because they had no faith in god and did not trust his saving power.
Psalm 78:23: yet he commanded the skies above and opened the doors of heaven;
Psalm 78:24: he rained down on them manna to eat and gave them the grain of heaven.
Psalm 78:25: mortals ate of the bread of angels; he sent them food in abundance.
Psalm 78:26: he caused the east wind to blow in the heavens, and by his power he led out the south wind;
Psalm 78:27: he rained flesh upon them like dust, winged birds like the sand of the seas;
Psalm 78:28: he let them fall within their camp, all around their dwellings.
Psalm 78:29: and they ate and were well filled, for he gave them what they craved.
Psalm 78:30: but before they had satisfied their craving, while the food was still in their mouths,
Psalm 78:31: the anger of god rose against them, and he killed the strongest of them and laid low the flower of israel.
Psalm 78:32: in spite of all this they still sinned; they did not believe in his wonders.
Psalm 78:33: so he made their days vanish like a breath and their years in terror.
Psalm 78:34: when he killed them, they searched for him; they repented and sought god earnestly.
Psalm 78:35: they remembered that god was their rock, the most high god their redeemer.
Psalm 78:36: but they flattered him with their mouths; they lied to him with their tongues.
Psalm 78:37: their heart was not steadfast toward him; they were not true to his covenant.
Psalm 78:38: yet he, being compassionate, forgave their iniquity and did not destroy them; often he restrained his anger and did not stir up all his wrath.
Psalm 78:39: he remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes and does not come again.
Psalm 78:40: how often they rebelled against him in the wilderness and grieved him in the desert!
Psalm 78:41: they tested god again and again and provoked the holy one of israel.
Psalm 78:42: they did not keep in mind his power or the day when he redeemed them from the foe,
Psalm 78:43: when he displayed his signs in egypt and his miracles in the fields of zoan.
Psalm 78:44: he turned their rivers to blood, so that they could not drink of their streams.
Psalm 78:45: he sent among them swarms of flies that devoured them and frogs that destroyed them.
Psalm 78:46: he gave their crops to the caterpillar and the fruit of their labor to the locust.
Psalm 78:47: he destroyed their vines with hail and their sycamores with frost.
Psalm 78:48: he gave over their cattle to the hail and their flocks to thunderbolts.
Psalm 78:49: he let loose on them his fierce anger, wrath, indignation, and distress, a company of destroying angels.
Psalm 78:50: he made a path for his anger; he did not spare them from death but gave their lives over to the plague.

Psalm 78:52: then he led out his people like sheep and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
Psalm 78:53: he led them in safety so that they were not afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

Psalm 78:55: he drove out nations before them; he apportioned them for a possession and settled the tribes of israel in their tents.
Psalm 78:56: yet they tested the most high god and rebelled against him. they did not observe his decrees
Psalm 78:57: but turned away and were faithless like their ancestors; they twisted like a treacherous bow.
Psalm 78:58: for they provoked him to anger with their high places; they moved him to jealousy with their idols.
Psalm 78:59: when god heard, he was full of wrath, and he utterly rejected israel.
Psalm 78:60: he abandoned his dwelling at shiloh, the tent where he dwelt among mortals,
Psalm 78:61: and delivered his power to captivity, his glory to the hand of the foe.

Psalm 105:11: saying, “to you i will give the land of canaan as your portion for an inheritance.”
Psalm 105:12: when they were few in number, of little account and strangers in it,
Psalm 105:13: wandering from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people,
Psalm 105:14: he allowed no one to oppress them; he rebuked kings on their account,
Psalm 105:15: saying, “do not touch my anointed ones; do my prophets no harm.”
Psalm 105:16: when he summoned famine against the land and cut off every supply of bread,

Psalm 105:18: his feet were hurt with fetters; his neck was put in a collar of iron;
Psalm 105:19: until what he had said came to pass, the word of the lord kept testing him.
Psalm 105:20: the king sent and released him; the ruler of the peoples set him free.
Psalm 105:21: he made him lord of his house and ruler of all his possessions,
Psalm 105:22: to instruct his officials at his pleasure and to teach his elders wisdom.
Psalm 105:23: then israel came to egypt; jacob lived as an alien in the land of ham.
Psalm 105:24: and the lord made his people very fruitful and made them stronger than their foes,
Psalm 105:25: whose hearts he then turned to hate his people, to deal craftily with his servants.
Psalm 105:26: he sent his servant moses and aaron, whom he had chosen.
Psalm 105:27: they performed his signs among them and miracles in the land of ham.
Psalm 105:28: he sent darkness and made the land dark; they rebelled against his words.
Psalm 105:29: he turned their waters into blood and caused their fish to die.
Psalm 105:30: their land swarmed with frogs, even in the chambers of their kings.
Psalm 105:31: he spoke, and there came swarms of flies and gnats throughout their country.
Psalm 105:32: he gave them hail for rain and lightning that flashed through their land.
Psalm 105:33: he struck their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.
Psalm 105:34: he spoke, and the locusts came, and young locusts without number;
Psalm 105:35: they devoured all the vegetation in their land and ate up the fruit of their ground.
Psalm 105:36: he struck down all the firstborn in their land, the first issue of all their strength.
Psalm 105:37: then he brought israel out with silver and gold, and there was no one among their tribes who stumbled.
Psalm 105:38: egypt was glad when they departed, for dread of them had fallen upon it.
Psalm 105:39: he spread a cloud for a covering and fire to give light by night.
Psalm 105:40: they asked, and he brought quails and gave them food from heaven in abundance.
Psalm 105:41: he opened the rock, and water gushed out; it flowed through the desert like a river.
Psalm 105:42: for he remembered his holy promise and abraham, his servant.
Psalm 105:43: so he brought his people out with joy, his chosen ones with singing.
Psalm 105:44: he gave them the lands of the nations, and they took possession of the wealth of the peoples,
Psalm 105:45: that they might keep his statutes and observe his laws. praise the lord!
Psalm 106:1: praise the lord! o give thanks to the lord, for he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever.
Psalm 106:2: who can utter the mighty doings of the lord or declare all his praise?
Psalm 106:3: happy are those who observe justice, who do righteousness at all times.
Psalm 106:4: remember us, o lord, when you show favor to your people; help us when you deliver them,
Psalm 106:5: that we may see the prosperity of your chosen ones, that we may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that we may glory in your heritage.
Psalm 106:6: both we and our ancestors have sinned; we have committed iniquity, have done wickedly.
Psalm 106:7: our ancestors, when they were in egypt, did not consider your wonderful works; they did not remember the abundance of your steadfast love but rebelled against the most high at the red sea.
Psalm 106:8: yet he saved them for his name’s sake, so that he might make known his mighty power.
Psalm 106:9: he rebuked the red sea, and it became dry; he led them through the deep as through a desert.
Psalm 106:10: so he saved them from the hand of the foe and delivered them from the hand of the enemy.
Psalm 106:11: the waters covered their adversaries; not one of them was left.
Psalm 106:12: then they believed his words; they sang his praise.
Psalm 106:13: but they soon forgot his works; they did not wait for his counsel.
Psalm 106:14: but they had a wanton craving in the wilderness and put god to the test in the desert;
Psalm 106:15: he gave them what they asked but sent a wasting disease among them.
Psalm 106:16: they were jealous of moses in the camp and of aaron, the holy one of the lord.
Psalm 106:17: the earth opened and swallowed up dathan and covered the faction of abiram.
Psalm 106:18: fire also broke out in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
Psalm 106:19: they made a calf at horeb and worshiped a cast image.
Psalm 106:20: they exchanged the glory of god for the image of an ox that eats grass.
Psalm 106:21: they forgot god, their savior, who had done great things in egypt,
Psalm 106:22: wondrous works in the land of ham, and awesome deeds by the red sea.
Psalm 106:23: therefore he said he would destroy them— had not moses, his chosen one, stood in the breach before him, to turn away his wrath from destroying them.
Psalm 106:24: then they despised the pleasant land, having no faith in his promise.
Psalm 106:25: they grumbled in their tents and did not obey the voice of the lord.
Psalm 106:26: therefore he raised his hand and swore to them that he would make them fall in the wilderness
Psalm 106:27: and would disperse their descendants among the nations, scattering them over the lands.
Psalm 106:28: then they attached themselves to the baal of peor and ate sacrifices offered to the dead;
Psalm 106:29: they provoked the lord to anger with their deeds, and a plague broke out among them.
Psalm 106:30: then phinehas stood up and interceded, and the plague was stopped.
Psalm 106:31: and that has been reckoned to him as righteousness from generation to generation forever.
Psalm 106:32: they angered the lord at the waters of meribah, and it went ill with moses on their account,
Psalm 106:33: for they made his spirit bitter, and he spoke words that were rash.
Psalm 106:34: they did not destroy the peoples, as the lord had commanded them,
Psalm 106:35: but they mingled with the nations and learned to do as they did.
Psalm 106:36: they served their idols, which became a snare to them.
Psalm 106:37: they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to the demons;
Psalm 106:38: they poured out innocent blood, the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of canaan, and the land was polluted with blood.
Psalm 106:39: thus they became unclean by their acts and prostituted themselves in their doings.
Psalm 106:40: then the anger of the lord was kindled against his people, and he abhorred his heritage;
Psalm 106:41: he gave them into the hand of the nations, so that those who hated them ruled over them.
Psalm 106:42: their enemies oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their power.
Psalm 106:43: many times he delivered them, but they were rebellious in their purposes and were brought low through their iniquity.
Psalm 106:44: nevertheless, he regarded their distress when he heard their cry.
Psalm 106:45: for their sake he remembered his covenant and showed compassion according to the abundance of his steadfast love.
Psalm 106:46: he caused them to be pitied by all who held them captive.
Psalm 106:47: save us, o lord our god, and gather us from among the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name and glory in your praise.
Psalm 106:48: blessed be the lord, the god of israel, from everlasting to everlasting. and let all the people say, “amen.” praise the lord!
Psalm 107:1: o give thanks to the lord, for he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever.
Psalm 107:2: let the redeemed of the lord say so, those he redeemed from trouble
Psalm 107:3: and gathered in from the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.
Psalm 107:4: some wandered in desert wastes, finding no way to an inhabited town;
Psalm 107:5: hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted within them.
Psalm 107:6: then they cried to the lord in their trouble, and he delivered them from their distress;
Psalm 107:7: he led them by a straight way, until they reached an inhabited town.
Psalm 107:8: let them thank the lord for his steadfast love, for his wonderful works to humankind.
Psalm 107:9: for he satisfies the thirsty, and the hungry he fills with good things.
Psalm 107:10: some sat in darkness and in gloom, prisoners in misery and in irons,
Psalm 107:11: for they had rebelled against the words of god and spurned the counsel of the most high.
Psalm 107:12: their hearts were bowed down with hard labor; they fell down, with no one to help.
Psalm 107:13: then they cried to the lord in their trouble, and he saved them from their distress;
Psalm 107:14: he brought them out of darkness and gloom, and broke their bonds apart.
Psalm 107:15: let them thank the lord for his steadfast love, for his wonderful works to humankind.
Psalm 107:16: for he shatters the doors of bronze and cuts in two the bars of iron.
Psalm 107:17: some were sick through their sinful ways and because of their iniquities endured affliction;

Psalm 107:19: then they cried to the lord in their trouble, and he saved them from their distress;
Psalm 107:20: he sent out his word and healed them and delivered them from destruction.
Psalm 107:21: let them thank the lord for his steadfast love, for his wonderful works to humankind.
Psalm 107:22: and let them offer thanksgiving sacrifices and tell of his deeds with songs of joy.
Psalm 107:23: some went down to the sea in ships, doing business on the mighty waters;
Psalm 107:24: they saw the deeds of the lord, his wondrous works in the deep.
Psalm 107:25: for he commanded and raised the stormy wind, which lifted up the waves of the sea.
Psalm 107:26: they mounted up to heaven; they went down to the depths; their courage melted away in their calamity;
Psalm 107:27: they reeled and staggered like drunkards and were at their wits’ end.
Psalm 107:28: then they cried to the lord in their trouble, and he brought them out from their distress;
Psalm 107:29: he made the storm be still, and the waves of the sea were hushed.
Psalm 107:30: then they were glad because they had quiet, and he brought them to their desired haven.
Psalm 107:31: let them thank the lord for his steadfast love, for his wonderful works to humankind.
Psalm 107:32: let them extol him in the congregation of the people and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
Psalm 107:33: he turns rivers into a desert, springs of water into thirsty ground,
Psalm 107:34: a fruitful land into a salty waste, because of the wickedness of its inhabitants.
Psalm 107:35: he turns a desert into pools of water, a parched land into springs of water.
Psalm 107:36: and there he lets the hungry live, and they establish a town to live in;
Psalm 107:37: they sow fields and plant vineyards and get a fruitful yield.
Psalm 107:38: by his blessing they multiply greatly, and he does not let their cattle decrease.
Psalm 107:39: when they are diminished and brought low through oppression, trouble, and sorrow,
Psalm 107:40: he pours contempt on princes and makes them wander in trackless wastes,
Psalm 107:41: but he raises up the needy out of distress and makes their families like flocks.
Psalm 107:42: the upright see it and are glad, and all wickedness stops its mouth.
Psalm 107:43: let those who are wise pay attention to these things and consider the steadfast love of the lord.
Psalm 108:1: my heart is steadfast, o god, my heart is steadfast; i will sing and make melody. awake, my soul!
Psalm 108:2: awake, o harp and lyre! i will awake the dawn.
Psalm 108:3: i will give thanks to you, o lord, among the peoples, and i will sing praises to you among the nations.
Psalm 108:4: for your steadfast love is higher than the heavens, and your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
Psalm 108:5: be exalted, o god, above the heavens, and let your glory be over all the earth.
Psalm 108:6: give victory with your right hand, and answer me, so that those whom you love may be rescued.
Psalm 108:7: god has promised in his sanctuary: “with exultation i will divide up shechem and portion out the vale of succoth.
Psalm 108:8: gilead is mine; manasseh is mine; ephraim is my helmet; judah is my scepter.
Psalm 108:9: moab is my washbasin; on edom i hurl my shoe; over philistia i shout in triumph.”
Psalm 108:10: who will bring me to the fortified city? who will lead me to edom?
Psalm 108:11: have you not rejected us, o god? you do not go out, o god, with our armies.
Psalm 108:12: o grant us help against the foe, for human help is worthless.
Psalm 108:13: with god we shall do valiantly; it is he who will tread down our foes.
Psalm 109:1: do not be silent, o god of my praise.
Psalm 109:2: for wicked and deceitful mouths are opened against me, speaking against me with lying tongues.
Psalm 109:3: they surround me with words of hate and attack me without cause.
Psalm 109:4: in return for my love they accuse me, even while i make prayer for them.
Psalm 109:5: so they reward me evil for good and hatred for my love.
Psalm 109:6: they say, “appoint a wicked man against him; let an accuser stand on his right.
Psalm 109:7: when he is tried, let him be found guilty; let his prayer be counted as sin.
Psalm 109:8: may his days be few; may another seize his position.
Psalm 109:9: may his children be orphans and his wife a widow.
Psalm 109:10: may his children wander about and beg; may they be driven out of the ruins they inhabit.
Psalm 109:11: may the creditor seize all that he has; may strangers plunder the fruits of his toil.
Psalm 109:12: may there be no one to do him a kindness nor anyone to pity his orphaned children.
Psalm 109:13: may his posterity be cut off; may his name be blotted out in the second generation.
Psalm 109:14: may the iniquity of his father be remembered before the lord, and do not let the sin of his mother be blotted out.
Psalm 109:15: let them be before the lord continually, and may his memory be cut off from the earth.
Psalm 109:16: for he did not remember to show kindness but pursued the poor and needy and the brokenhearted to their death.
Psalm 109:17: he loved to curse; let curses come on him. he did not like blessing; may it be far from him.
Psalm 109:18: he clothed himself with cursing as his coat; may it soak into his body like water, like oil into his bones.
Psalm 109:19: may it be like a garment that he wraps around himself, like a belt that he wears every day.”
Psalm 109:20: may that be the reward of my accusers from the lord, of those who speak evil against my life.
Psalm 109:21: but you, o lord my lord, act on my behalf for your name’s sake; because your steadfast love is good, deliver me.
Psalm 109:22: for i am poor and needy, and my heart is pierced within me.
Psalm 109:23: i am gone like a shadow at evening; i am shaken off like a locust.
Psalm 109:24: my knees are weak through fasting; my body has become gaunt.
Psalm 109:25: i am an object of scorn to my accusers; when they see me, they shake their heads.
Psalm 109:26: help me, o lord my god! save me according to your steadfast love.
Psalm 109:27: let them know that this is your hand; you, o lord, have done it.
Psalm 109:28: let them curse, but you will bless. let my assailants be put to shame; may your servant be glad.
Psalm 109:29: may my accusers be clothed with dishonor; may they be wrapped in their own shame as in a mantle.
Psalm 109:30: with my mouth i will give great thanks to the lord; i will praise him in the midst of the throng.
Psalm 109:31: for he stands at the right hand of the needy, to save them from those who would condemn them to death.
Psalm 110:1: the lord says to my lord, “sit at my right hand until i make your enemies your footstool.”

Psalm 110:4: the lord has sworn and will not change his mind, “you are a priest forever according to the order of melchizedek.”
Psalm 110:5: the lord is at your right hand; he will shatter kings on the day of his wrath.

Psalm 111:1: praise the lord! i will give thanks to the lord with my whole heart, in the company of the upright, in the congregation.
Psalm 111:2: great are the works of the lord, studied by all who delight in them.
Psalm 111:3: full of honor and majesty is his work, and his righteousness endures forever.
Psalm 111:4: he has gained renown by his wonderful deeds; the lord is gracious and merciful.
Psalm 111:5: he provides food for those who fear him; he is ever mindful of his covenant.
Psalm 111:6: he has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.
Psalm 111:7: the works of his hands are faithful and just; all his precepts are trustworthy.

Psalm 112:1: praise the lord! happy are those who fear the lord, who greatly delight in his commandments.
Psalm 112:2: their descendants will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.

Psalm 112:5: it is well with those who deal generously and lend, who conduct their affairs with justice.

Psalm 112:7: they are not afraid of evil tidings; their hearts are firm, secure in the lord.

Psalm 113:1: praise the lord! praise, o servants of the lord; praise the name of the lord.
Psalm 113:2: blessed be the name of the lord from this time on and forevermore.
Psalm 113:3: from the rising of the sun to its setting, the name of the lord is to be praised.
Psalm 113:4: the lord is high above all nations and his glory above the heavens.
Psalm 113:5: who is like the lord our god, who is seated on high,

Psalm 113:7: he raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap,

Psalm 114:1: when israel went out from egypt, the house of jacob from a people of strange language,

Psalm 115:1: not to us, o lord, not to us, but to your name give glory, for the sake of your steadfast love and your faithfulness.

Psalm 115:3: our god is in the heavens; he does whatever he pleases.
Psalm 115:4: their idols are silver and gold, the work of human hands.
Psalm 115:5: they have mouths, but they do not speak; they have eyes, but they do not see.
Psalm 115:6: they have ears, but they do not hear; they have noses, but they do not smell.
Psalm 115:7: they have hands, but they do not feel; they have feet, but they do not walk; they make no sound in their throats.
Psalm 115:8: those who make them are like them; so are all who trust in them.
Psalm 115:9: o israel, trust in the lord! he is their help and their shield.
Psalm 115:10: o house of aaron, trust in the lord! he is their help and their shield.
Psalm 115:11: you who fear the lord, trust in the lord! he is their help and their shield.
Psalm 115:12: the lord has been mindful of us; he will bless us; he will bless the house of israel; he will bless the house of aaron;
Psalm 115:13: he will bless those who fear the lord, both small and great.
Psalm 115:14: may the lord give you increase, both you and your children.
Psalm 115:15: may you be blessed by the lord, who made heaven and earth.
Psalm 115:16: the heavens are the lord’s heavens, but the earth he has given to human beings.
Psalm 115:17: the dead do not praise the lord, nor do any who go down into silence.
Psalm 115:18: but we will bless the lord from this time on and forevermore. praise the lord!
Psalm 116:1: i love the lord because he has heard my voice and my supplications.
Psalm 116:2: because he inclined his ear to me, therefore i will call on him as long as i live.
Psalm 116:3: the snares of death encompassed me; the pangs of sheol laid hold on me; i suffered distress and anguish.
Psalm 116:4: then i called on the name of the lord, “o lord, i pray, save my life!”
Psalm 116:5: gracious is the lord and righteous; our god is merciful.
Psalm 116:6: the lord protects the simple; when i was brought low, he saved me.
Psalm 116:7: return, o my soul, to your rest, for the lord has dealt bountifully with you.
Psalm 116:8: for you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
Psalm 116:9: i walk before the lord in the land of the living.
Psalm 116:10: i kept my faith, even when i said, “i am greatly afflicted”;
Psalm 116:11: i said in my consternation, “everyone is a liar.”

Psalm 116:17: i will offer to you a thanksgiving sacrifice and call on the name of the lord.
Psalm 116:18: i will pay my vows to the lord in the presence of all his people,

Psalm 117:1: praise the lord, all you nations! extol him, all you peoples!

Psalm 118:1: o give thanks to the lord, for he is good; his steadfast love endures forever!

Psalm 118:3: let the house of aaron say, “his steadfast love endures forever.”
Psalm 118:4: let those who fear the lord say, “his steadfast love endures forever.”
Psalm 118:5: out of my distress i called on the lord; the lord answered me and set me in a broad place.
Psalm 118:6: with the lord on my side i do not fear. what can mortals do to me?
Psalm 118:7: the lord is on my side to help me; i shall look in triumph on those who hate me.
Psalm 118:8: it is better to take refuge in the lord than to put confidence in mortals.
Psalm 118:9: it is better to take refuge in the lord than to put confidence in princes.
Psalm 118:10: all nations surrounded me; in the name of the lord i cut them off!
Psalm 118:11: they surrounded me, surrounded me on every side; in the name of the lord i cut them off!
Psalm 118:12: they surrounded me like bees; they blazed like a fire of thorns; in the name of the lord i cut them off!
Psalm 118:13: i was pushed hard, so that i was falling, but the lord helped me.
Psalm 118:14: the lord is my strength and my might; he has become my salvation.
Psalm 118:15: there are glad songs of victory in the tents of the righteous: “the right hand of the lord does valiantly;

Psalm 118:17: i shall not die, but i shall live and recount the deeds of the lord.

Psalm 118:19: open to me the gates of righteousness, that i may enter through them and give thanks to the lord.
Psalm 118:20: this is the gate of the lord; the righteous shall enter through it.
Psalm 118:21: i thank you that you have answered me and have become my salvation.

Psalm 118:23: this is the lord’s doing; it is marvelous in our eyes.
Psalm 118:24: this is the day that the lord has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.
Psalm 118:25: save us, we beseech you, o lord! o lord, we beseech you, give us success!

Psalm 118:28: you are my god, and i will give thanks to you; you are my god; i will extol you.
Psalm 118:29: o give thanks to the lord, for he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever.
Psalm 119:1: happy are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the law of the lord.
Psalm 119:2: happy are those who keep his decrees, who seek him with their whole heart,
Psalm 119:3: who also do no wrong but walk in his ways.
Psalm 119:4: you have commanded your precepts to be kept diligently.
Psalm 119:5: o that my ways may be steadfast in keeping your statutes!
Psalm 119:6: then i shall not be put to shame, having my eyes fixed on all your commandments.
Psalm 119:7: i will praise you with an upright heart, when i learn your righteous ordinances.
Psalm 119:8: i will observe your statutes; do not utterly forsake me.
Psalm 119:9: how can young people keep their way pure? by guarding it according to your word.
Psalm 119:10: with my whole heart i seek you; do not let me stray from your commandments.
Psalm 119:11: i treasure your word in my heart, so that i may not sin against you.
Psalm 119:12: blessed are you, o lord; teach me your statutes.
Psalm 119:13: with my lips i declare all the ordinances of your mouth.
Psalm 119:14: i delight in the way of your decrees as much as in all riches.
Psalm 119:15: i will meditate on your precepts and fix my eyes on your ways.
Psalm 119:16: i will delight in your statutes; i will not forget your word.
Psalm 119:17: deal bountifully with your servant, so that i may live and observe your word.
Psalm 119:18: open my eyes, so that i may behold wondrous things out of your law.
Psalm 119:19: i live as an alien in the land; do not hide your commandments from me.
Psalm 119:20: my soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
Psalm 119:21: you rebuke the insolent, accursed ones, who wander from your commandments;
Psalm 119:22: take away from me their scorn and contempt, for i have kept your decrees.
Psalm 119:23: even though princes sit plotting against me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.
Psalm 119:24: your decrees are my delight; they are my counselors.
Psalm 119:25: my soul clings to the dust; revive me according to your word.
Psalm 119:26: when i told of my ways, you answered me; teach me your statutes.
Psalm 119:27: make me understand the way of your precepts, and i will meditate on your wondrous works.
Psalm 119:28: my soul melts away for sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.
Psalm 119:29: put false ways far from me, and graciously teach me your law.
Psalm 119:30: i have chosen the way of faithfulness; i set your ordinances before me.
Psalm 119:31: i cling to your decrees, o lord; let me not be put to shame.
Psalm 119:32: i run the way of your commandments, for you enlarge my understanding.
Psalm 119:33: teach me, o lord, the way of your statutes, and i will observe it to the end.
Psalm 119:34: give me understanding, that i may keep your law and observe it with my whole heart.
Psalm 119:35: lead me in the path of your commandments, for i delight in it.
Psalm 119:36: turn my heart to your decrees and not to selfish gain.
Psalm 119:37: turn my eyes from looking at vanities; be gracious to me according to your word.
Psalm 119:38: confirm to your servant your promise, which is for those who fear you.
Psalm 119:39: turn away the disgrace that i dread, for your ordinances are good.
Psalm 119:40: see, i have longed for your precepts; in your righteousness be gracious to me.
Psalm 119:41: let your steadfast love come to me, o lord, your salvation according to your promise.
Psalm 119:42: then i shall have an answer for those who taunt me, for i trust in your word.
Psalm 119:43: do not take the word of truth utterly out of my mouth, for my hope is in your ordinances.
Psalm 119:44: i will keep your law continually, forever and ever.
Psalm 119:45: i shall walk at liberty, for i have sought your precepts.
Psalm 119:46: i will also speak of your decrees before kings and shall not be put to shame;
Psalm 119:47: i find my delight in your commandments because i love them.
Psalm 119:48: i revere your commandments, which i love, and i will meditate on your statutes.
Psalm 119:49: remember your word to your servant, in which you have made me hope.
Psalm 119:50: this is my comfort in my distress, that your promise gives me life.
Psalm 119:51: the arrogant utterly deride me, but i do not turn away from your law.
Psalm 119:52: when i think of your ordinances from of old, i take comfort, o lord.
Psalm 119:53: hot indignation seizes me because of the wicked, those who forsake your law.
Psalm 119:54: your statutes have been my songs wherever i make my home.
Psalm 119:55: i remember your name in the night, o lord, and keep your law.
Psalm 119:56: this blessing has fallen to me, for i have kept your precepts.
Psalm 119:57: the lord is my portion; i promise to keep your words.
Psalm 119:58: i implore your favor with all my heart; be gracious to me according to your promise.
Psalm 119:59: when i think of your ways, i turn my feet to your decrees;
Psalm 119:60: i hurry and do not delay to keep your commandments.
Psalm 119:61: though the cords of the wicked ensnare me, i do not forget your law.
Psalm 119:62: at midnight i rise to praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.
Psalm 119:63: i am a companion of all who fear you, of those who keep your precepts.
Psalm 119:64: the earth, o lord, is full of your steadfast love; teach me your statutes.
Psalm 119:65: you have dealt well with your servant, o lord, according to your word.
Psalm 119:66: teach me good judgment and knowledge, for i believe in your commandments.
Psalm 119:67: before i was humbled i went astray, but now i keep your word.
Psalm 119:68: you are good and do good; teach me your statutes.
Psalm 119:69: the arrogant smear me with lies, but with my whole heart i keep your precepts.
Psalm 119:70: their hearts are thick like fat, but i delight in your law.
Psalm 119:71: it is good for me that i was humbled, so that i might learn your statutes.
Psalm 119:72: the law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver pieces.
Psalm 119:73: your hands have made and fashioned me; give me understanding that i may learn your commandments.
Psalm 119:74: those who fear you shall see me and rejoice, because i have hoped in your word.
Psalm 119:75: i know, o lord, that your judgments are right and that in faithfulness you have humbled me.
Psalm 119:76: let your steadfast love become my comfort according to your promise to your servant.
Psalm 119:77: let your mercy come to me, that i may live, for your law is my delight.
Psalm 119:78: let the arrogant be put to shame, for they have subverted me with guile; as for me, i will meditate on your precepts.
Psalm 119:79: let those who fear you turn to me, so that they may know your decrees.
Psalm 119:80: may my heart be blameless in your statutes, so that i may not be put to shame.
Psalm 119:81: my soul languishes for your salvation; i hope in your word.
Psalm 119:82: my eyes fail with watching for your promise; i ask, “when will you comfort me?”
Psalm 119:83: for i have become like a wineskin in the smoke, yet i have not forgotten your statutes.
Psalm 119:84: how long must your servant endure? when will you judge those who persecute me?
Psalm 119:85: the arrogant have dug pitfalls for me; they flout your law.
Psalm 119:86: all your commandments are enduring; i am persecuted without cause; help me!
Psalm 119:87: they have almost made an end of me on earth, but i have not forsaken your precepts.
Psalm 119:88: in your steadfast love spare my life, so that i may keep the decrees of your mouth.
Psalm 119:89: the lord exists forever; your word is firmly fixed in heaven.
Psalm 119:90: your faithfulness endures to all generations; you have established the earth, and it stands fast.
Psalm 119:91: by your appointment they stand today, for all things are your servants.
Psalm 119:92: if your law had not been my delight, i would have perished in my misery.
Psalm 119:93: i will never forget your precepts, for by them you have given me life.
Psalm 119:94: i am yours; save me, for i have sought your precepts.
Psalm 119:95: the wicked lie in wait to destroy me, but i consider your decrees.
Psalm 119:96: i have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commandment is exceedingly broad.
Psalm 119:97: oh, how i love your law! it is my meditation all day long.
Psalm 119:98: your commandment makes me wiser than my enemies, for it is always with me.
Psalm 119:99: i have more understanding than all my teachers, for your decrees are my meditation.
Psalm 119:100: i understand more than the aged, for i keep your precepts.
Psalm 119:101: i hold back my feet from every evil way, in order to keep your word.
Psalm 119:102: i do not turn away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.
Psalm 119:103: how sweet are your words to my taste, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
Psalm 119:104: through your precepts i get understanding; therefore i hate every false way.
Psalm 119:105: your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
Psalm 119:106: i have sworn an oath and confirmed it, to observe your righteous ordinances.
Psalm 119:107: i am severely afflicted; give me life, o lord, according to your word.
Psalm 119:108: accept my offerings of praise, o lord, and teach me your ordinances.
Psalm 119:109: i hold my life in my hand continually, but i do not forget your law.
Psalm 119:110: the wicked have laid a snare for me, but i do not stray from your precepts.
Psalm 119:111: your decrees are my heritage forever; they are the joy of my heart.
Psalm 119:112: i incline my heart to perform your statutes forever, to the end.
Psalm 119:113: i hate the double-minded, but i love your law.
Psalm 119:114: you are my hiding place and my shield; i hope in your word.
Psalm 119:115: go away from me, you evildoers, that i may keep the commandments of my god.
Psalm 119:116: uphold me according to your promise, that i may live, and let me not be put to shame in my hope.
Psalm 119:117: hold me up, that i may be safe and have regard for your statutes continually.
Psalm 119:118: you spurn all who go astray from your statutes, for their cunning is in vain.
Psalm 119:119: all the wicked of the earth i count as dross; therefore i love your decrees.
Psalm 119:120: my flesh trembles for fear of you, and i am afraid of your judgments.
Psalm 119:121: i have done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors.
Psalm 119:122: guarantee your servant’s well-being; do not let the godless oppress me.
Psalm 119:123: my eyes fail from watching for your salvation and for the fulfillment of your righteous promise.
Psalm 119:124: deal with your servant according to your steadfast love, and teach me your statutes.
Psalm 119:125: i am your servant; give me understanding, so that i may know your decrees.
Psalm 119:126: it is time for the lord to act, for your law has been broken.
Psalm 119:127: truly i love your commandments more than gold, more than fine gold.
Psalm 119:128: truly i direct my steps by all your precepts; i hate every false way.
Psalm 119:129: your decrees are wonderful; therefore my soul keeps them.
Psalm 119:130: the unfolding of your words gives light; it imparts understanding to the simple.
Psalm 119:131: with open mouth i pant, because i long for your commandments.
Psalm 119:132: turn to me and be gracious to me, as is your custom toward those who love your name.
Psalm 119:133: keep my steps steady according to your promise, and never let iniquity have dominion over me.
Psalm 119:134: redeem me from human oppression, that i may keep your precepts.
Psalm 119:135: make your face shine upon your servant, and teach me your statutes.
Psalm 119:136: my eyes shed streams of tears because your law is not kept.
Psalm 119:137: you are righteous, o lord, and your judgments are right.
Psalm 119:138: you have appointed your decrees in righteousness and in all faithfulness.
Psalm 119:139: my zeal consumes me because my foes forget your words.
Psalm 119:140: your promise is well tried, and your servant loves it.
Psalm 119:141: i am small and despised, yet i do not forget your precepts.
Psalm 119:142: your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and your law is the truth.
Psalm 119:143: trouble and anguish have come upon me, but your commandments are my delight.
Psalm 119:144: your decrees are righteous forever; give me understanding that i may live.
Psalm 119:145: with my whole heart i cry; answer me, o lord. i will keep your statutes.
Psalm 119:146: i cry to you; save me, that i may observe your decrees.
Psalm 119:147: i rise before dawn and cry for help; i put my hope in your words.
Psalm 119:148: my eyes are awake before each watch of the night, that i may meditate on your promise.
Psalm 119:149: in your steadfast love hear my voice; o lord, in your justice preserve my life.
Psalm 119:150: those who persecute me with evil purpose draw near; they are far from your law.
Psalm 119:151: yet you are near, o lord, and all your commandments are true.
Psalm 119:152: long ago i learned from your decrees that you have established them forever.
Psalm 119:153: look on my misery and rescue me, for i do not forget your law.
Psalm 119:154: plead my cause and redeem me; give me life according to your promise.
Psalm 119:155: salvation is far from the wicked, for they do not seek your statutes.
Psalm 119:156: great is your mercy, o lord; be gracious to me according to your justice.
Psalm 119:157: many are my persecutors and my adversaries, yet i do not swerve from your decrees.
Psalm 119:158: i look at the faithless with disgust because they do not keep your commands.
Psalm 119:159: consider how i love your precepts; be gracious to me according to your steadfast love.
Psalm 119:160: the sum of your word is truth, and every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever.
Psalm 119:161: princes persecute me without cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.
Psalm 119:162: i rejoice at your word like one who finds great spoil.
Psalm 119:163: i hate and abhor falsehood, but i love your law.
Psalm 119:164: seven times a day i praise you for your righteous ordinances.
Psalm 119:165: great peace have those who love your law; nothing can make them stumble.
Psalm 119:166: i hope for your salvation, o lord, and i fulfill your commandments.
Psalm 119:167: my soul keeps your decrees; i love them exceedingly.
Psalm 119:168: i keep your precepts and decrees, for all my ways are before you.
Psalm 119:169: let my cry come before you, o lord; give me understanding according to your word.
Psalm 119:170: let my supplication come before you; deliver me according to your promise.
Psalm 119:171: my lips will pour forth praise, because you teach me your statutes.
Psalm 119:172: my tongue will sing of your promise, for all your commandments are right.
Psalm 119:173: let your hand be ready to help me, for i have chosen your precepts.
Psalm 119:174: i long for your salvation, o lord, and your law is my delight.
Psalm 119:175: let me live that i may praise you, and let your ordinances help me.
Psalm 119:176: i have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek out your servant, for i do not forget your commandments.
Psalm 120:1: in my distress i cry to the lord, that he may answer me:
Psalm 120:2: “deliver me, o lord, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.”
Psalm 120:3: what shall be given to you? and what more shall be done to you, you deceitful tongue?
Psalm 120:4: a warrior’s sharp arrows, with glowing coals of the broom tree!
Psalm 120:5: woe is me, that i am an alien in meshech, that i must live among the tents of kedar.
Psalm 120:6: too long have i had my dwelling among those who hate peace.
Psalm 120:7: i am for peace, but when i speak, they are for war.
Psalm 121:1: i lift up my eyes to the hills— from where will my help come?
Psalm 121:2: my help comes from the lord, who made heaven and earth.
Psalm 121:3: he will not let your foot be moved; he who keeps you will not slumber.
Psalm 121:4: he who keeps israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
Psalm 121:5: the lord is your keeper; the lord is your shade at your right hand.
Psalm 121:6: the sun shall not strike you by day nor the moon by night.
Psalm 121:7: the lord will keep you from all evil; he will keep your life.
Psalm 121:8: the lord will keep your going out and your coming in from this time on and forevermore.
Psalm 122:1: i was glad when they said to me, “let us go to the house of the lord!”
Psalm 122:2: our feet are standing within your gates, o jerusalem.
Psalm 122:3: jerusalem—built as a city that is bound firmly together.
Psalm 122:4: to it the tribes go up, the tribes of the lord, as was decreed for israel, to give thanks to the name of the lord.
Psalm 122:5: for there the thrones for judgment were set up, the thrones of the house of david.
Psalm 122:6: pray for the peace of jerusalem: “may they prosper who love you.
Psalm 122:7: peace be within your walls and security within your towers.”
Psalm 122:8: for the sake of my relatives and friends i will say, “peace be within you.”
Psalm 122:9: for the sake of the house of the lord our god, i will seek your good.
Psalm 123:1: to you i lift up my eyes, o you who are enthroned in the heavens!
Psalm 123:2: as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the lord our god, until he has mercy upon us.
Psalm 123:3: have mercy upon us, o lord, have mercy upon us, for we have had more than enough of contempt.
Psalm 123:4: our soul has had more than its fill of the scorn of those who are at ease, of the contempt of the proud.
Psalm 124:1: if it had not been the lord who was on our side —let israel now say—
Psalm 124:2: if it had not been the lord who was on our side, when our enemies attacked us,
Psalm 124:3: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their anger was kindled against us;
Psalm 124:4: then the flood would have swept us away; the torrent would have gone over us;
Psalm 124:5: then over us would have gone the raging waters.
Psalm 124:6: blessed be the lord, who has not given us as prey to their teeth.
Psalm 124:7: we have escaped like a bird from the snare of the hunters; the snare is broken, and we have escaped.
Psalm 124:8: our help is in the name of the lord, who made heaven and earth.
Psalm 125:1: those who trust in the lord are like mount zion, which cannot be moved but abides forever.
Psalm 125:2: as the mountains surround jerusalem, so the lord surrounds his people from this time on and forevermore.
Psalm 125:3: for the scepter of wickedness shall not rest on the land allotted to the righteous, so that the righteous might not stretch out their hands to do wrong.
Psalm 125:4: do good, o lord, to those who are good and to those who are upright in their hearts.
Psalm 125:5: but those who turn aside to their own crooked ways, the lord will lead away with evildoers. peace be upon israel!
Psalm 126:1: when the lord restored the fortunes of zion, we were like those who dream.
Psalm 126:2: then our mouth was filled with laughter and our tongue with shouts of joy; then it was said among the nations, “the lord has done great things for them.”
Psalm 126:3: the lord has done great things for us, and we rejoiced.
Psalm 126:4: restore our fortunes, o lord, like the watercourses in the negeb.
Psalm 126:5: may those who sow in tears reap with shouts of joy.
Psalm 126:6: those who go out weeping, bearing the seed for sowing, shall come home with shouts of joy, carrying their sheaves.
Psalm 127:1: unless the lord builds the house, those who build it labor in vain. unless the lord guards the city, the guard keeps watch in vain.
Psalm 127:2: it is in vain that you rise up early and go late to rest, eating the bread of anxious toil, for he gives sleep to his beloved.
Psalm 127:3: sons are indeed a heritage from the lord, the fruit of the womb a reward.
Psalm 127:4: like arrows in the hand of a warrior are the sons of one’s youth.
Psalm 127:5: happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. he shall not be put to shame when he speaks with his enemies in the gate.
Psalm 128:1: happy is everyone who fears the lord, who walks in his ways.
Psalm 128:2: you shall eat the fruit of the labor of your hands; you shall be happy, and it shall go well with you.
Psalm 128:3: your wife will be like a fruitful vine within your house; your children will be like olive shoots around your table.
Psalm 128:4: thus shall the man be blessed who fears the lord.
Psalm 128:5: the lord bless you from zion. may you see the prosperity of jerusalem all the days of your life.
Psalm 128:6: may you see your children’s children. peace be upon israel!
Psalm 129:1: often have they attacked me from my youth —let israel now say—
Psalm 129:2: often have they attacked me from my youth, yet they have not prevailed against me.
Psalm 129:3: the plowers plowed on my back; they made their furrows long.
Psalm 129:4: the lord is righteous; he has cut the cords of the wicked.
Psalm 129:5: may all who hate zion be put to shame and turned backward.
Psalm 129:6: let them be like the grass on the housetops that withers before it grows up,
Psalm 129:7: with which reapers do not fill their hands or binders of sheaves their arms,
Psalm 129:8: while those who pass by do not say, “the blessing of the lord be upon you! we bless you in the name of the lord!”
Psalm 130:1: out of the depths i cry to you, o lord.
Psalm 130:2: lord, hear my voice! let your ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications!
Psalm 130:3: if you, o lord, should mark iniquities, lord, who could stand?
Psalm 130:4: but there is forgiveness with you, so that you may be revered.
Psalm 130:5: i wait for the lord; my soul waits, and in his word i hope;
Psalm 130:6: my soul waits for the lord more than those who watch for the morning, more than those who watch for the morning.
Psalm 130:7: o israel, hope in the lord! for with the lord there is steadfast love, and with him is great power to redeem.
Psalm 130:8: it is he who will redeem israel from all its iniquities.
Psalm 131:1: o lord, my heart is not lifted up; my eyes are not raised too high; i do not occupy myself with things too great and too marvelous for me.
Psalm 131:2: but i have calmed and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with its mother; my soul is like the weaned child that is with me.
Psalm 131:3: o israel, hope in the lord from this time on and forevermore.
Psalm 132:1: o lord, remember in david’s favor all the hardships he endured;
Psalm 132:2: how he swore to the lord and vowed to the mighty one of jacob,
Psalm 132:3: “i will not enter my house or get into my bed;
Psalm 132:4: i will not give sleep to my eyes or slumber to my eyelids,
Psalm 132:5: until i find a place for the lord, a dwelling place for the mighty one of jacob.”
Psalm 132:6: we heard of it in ephrathah; we found it in the fields of jaar.
Psalm 132:7: “let us go to his dwelling place; let us worship at his footstool.”
Psalm 132:8: rise up, o lord, and go to your resting place, you and the ark of your might.
Psalm 132:9: let your priests be clothed with righteousness, and let your faithful shout for joy.
Psalm 132:10: for your servant david’s sake do not turn away the face of your anointed one.
Psalm 132:11: the lord swore to david a sure oath from which he will not turn back: “one of the sons of your body i will set on your throne.
Psalm 132:12: if your sons keep my covenant and my decrees that i shall teach them, their sons also, forevermore, shall sit on your throne.”
Psalm 132:13: for the lord has chosen zion; he has desired it for his habitation:
Psalm 132:14: “this is my resting place forever; here i will reside, for i have desired it.
Psalm 132:15: i will abundantly bless its provisions; i will satisfy its poor with bread.
Psalm 132:16: its priests i will clothe with salvation, and its faithful will shout for joy.
Psalm 132:17: there i will cause a horn to sprout up for david; i have prepared a lamp for my anointed one.
Psalm 132:18: his enemies i will clothe with disgrace, but on him, his crown will gleam.”
Psalm 133:1: how very good and pleasant it is when kindred live together in unity!
Psalm 133:2: it is like the precious oil on the head, running down upon the beard, on the beard of aaron, running down over the collar of his robes.
Psalm 133:3: it is like the dew of hermon, which falls on the mountains of zion. for there the lord ordained his blessing, life forevermore.
Psalm 134:1: come, bless the lord, all you servants of the lord, who stand by night in the house of the lord!
Psalm 134:2: lift up your hands to the holy place, and bless the lord.
Psalm 134:3: may the lord, maker of heaven and earth, bless you from zion.
Psalm 135:1: praise the lord! praise the name of the lord; give praise, o servants of the lord,
Psalm 135:2: you who stand in the house of the lord, in the courts of the house of our god.
Psalm 135:3: praise the lord, for the lord is good; sing to his name, for he is gracious.
Psalm 135:4: for the lord has chosen jacob for himself, israel as his own possession.
Psalm 135:5: for i know that the lord is great; our lord is above all gods.
Psalm 135:6: whatever the lord pleases he does, in heaven and on earth, in the seas and all deeps.
Psalm 135:7: he it is who makes the clouds rise at the end of the earth; he makes lightnings for the rain and brings out the wind from his storehouses.
Psalm 135:8: he it was who struck down the firstborn of egypt, both humans and animals;
Psalm 135:9: he sent signs and wonders into your midst, o egypt, against pharaoh and all his servants.
Psalm 135:10: he struck down many nations and killed mighty kings—
Psalm 135:11: sihon, king of the amorites, and og, king of bashan, and all the kingdoms of canaan—
Psalm 135:12: and gave their land as a heritage, a heritage to his people israel.
Psalm 135:13: your name, o lord, endures forever, your renown, o lord, throughout all ages.
Psalm 135:14: for the lord will vindicate his people and have compassion on his servants.

Psalm 135:16: they have mouths, but they do not speak; they have eyes, but they do not see;

Psalm 135:19: o house of israel, bless the lord! o house of aaron, bless the lord!
Psalm 135:20: o house of levi, bless the lord! you who fear the lord, bless the lord!
Psalm 135:21: blessed be the lord from zion, he who resides in jerusalem. praise the lord!
